verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a consumer 2FA app, but the evidence shows no assistant or natural-language command interface. The llms.txt file documents Ente for LLMs rather than letting users operate the app. The export CLI and the enteauth://search deep links are structured, scriptable interfaces, not natural-language control, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
